item.title: Apple expands Siri AI to act across all third‑party iOS apps
item.description:
Apple expands Siri AI to act across all third‑party iOS apps

Apple announced that Siri AI can now perform actions across third‑party apps as part of the iOS 27.3 update.

🔍 Overview

  • Apple will now let Siri AI perform actions across third‑party apps.
  • The change is part of the iOS 27.3 update rolling out on Tuesday.
  • Developers can integrate Siri AI’s new features in “all apps,” allowing the voice assistant to draw on a user’s personal context, process natural language prompts, and use on‑screen awareness to complete requests.

🧩 How it works

  • Siri AI can use personal context, natural language prompts, and on‑screen awareness.
  • Users won’t have to mention an app’s name in their request while it’s in the foreground, during a Live Activity, or in a conversation with Siri AI about the app.

⚙️ Key details

  • A new “app skills” feature lets third‑party developers combine several tasks into a single action.
  • “For example, a person might request a ride with a ride share app, follow updates to the app’s Live Activity while they wait for their ride to arrive, then request to move the pickup location to a different address by saying ‘Hey Siri, change my ride pickup to a new address,’” Apple says.
  • Apple previously made a smaller set of features available to third‑party developers (as noted by 9to5Mac).

🚀 Availability

  • The update is rolling out as part of a Developer Preview and will be available with iOS 27.3.

📱 Expanded built‑in app support

Apple is bringing Siri AI’s expanded capabilities to its own apps as well, including:

App Siri AI Support
Calendar Expanded
Files Expanded
Finder Expanded
Journal Expanded
Mail Expanded
Maps Expanded
Messages Expanded
Music Expanded
Notes Expanded
Photos Expanded
Preview Expanded
Reminders Expanded
Safari Expanded
Shortcuts Expanded
Weather Expanded

💡 Why it matters

  • Users can ask Siri AI to find a coffee shop they visited last week.
  • Users can ask Siri AI to archive files that haven’t been opened in over a year.
  • Users can ask Siri AI what it can do in each app.

#Apple #SiriAI #iOS #ThirdPartyApps #AI

Source: Apple starts giving Siri AI access to third-party apps

item.title: Apple rolls out Apple Intelligence features to China with iOS 27.3
item.description:
Apple rolls out Apple Intelligence features to China with iOS 27.3

Apple announced that its Apple Intelligence suite is coming to China with the upcoming iOS 27.3 release.

📣 Overview

Apple will launch Apple Intelligence in China with iOS 27.3, as announced on the company’s Chinese newsroom site and reported by MacRumors.

⚙️ Key details

  • iOS 27.3 beta, containing initial Apple Intelligence features, launches on November 4.
  • The full iOS 27.3 release is scheduled for December.
  • Apple Intelligence received regulatory approval in China in July.
  • Apple trained its own large language model specifically for the Chinese market (Reuters, August).

🛠️ Features arriving in China

  • Notification summaries
  • Real‑time translation
  • Rewriting and proofreading tools
  • Visual intelligence
  • Removing objects from photos

🤖 AI chatbot integration

  • Apple worked with Alibaba to add support for its Qwen chatbot in some experiences, a setup similar to iOS’s integration with OpenAI’s ChatGPT launched in 2024.

🚫 What’s not included

  • The new Siri AI is not part of this China launch.

📅 Availability

  • iOS 27.3 beta (with the initial Apple Intelligence features) becomes available on November 4.
  • The full iOS 27.3 release follows in December.

#AppleIntelligence #iOS27 #ChinaAI

Source: Apple Intelligence is finally coming to China with iOS 27.3

item.title: Google pushes Android 17 developer preview with battery and privacy enhancements
item.description:
Google pushes Android 17 developer preview with battery and privacy enhancements

The Android ecosystem is busy this weekend as Google released a fresh update to the Android 17 developer preview, focusing on better battery life, background‑process control, and new privacy tweaks.

🔍 Overview

  • Android 17 developer preview arrives with a revamped battery settings menu.
  • Users can now see which background services consume the most power.
  • A new Private Space folder lets you hide specific apps from the app drawer without uninstalling them.
  • Notification snooze lets you silence alerts for one or two hours.

⚙️ Key Details

  • Battery Management
    • Revamped battery settings menu.
    • Visibility of power‑hungry background services.
  • App Privacy
    • Hide apps in the Private Space folder.
    • Google aims to help users find apps that behave badly.
  • Notification Control
    • Swipe a notification to the side for a snooze option.

📱 Additional Android Updates

  • Google Maps – Minor update adds the ability to save multiple custom routes as home‑screen shortcuts.
  • Google Photos – Refresh includes a faster search index for quicker object and person searches.
  • Security Patch – October security patch released for all supported Pixel devices, fixing three major flaws that could allow unauthorized media‑file access. Other manufacturers (OnePlus, Motorola) expected to roll it out by mid‑next week.

🚀 Availability

  • The Android 17 preview is now available for developers.
  • Google plans to open the beta to more devices soon.
  • Reminder: Back up your data before installing major system updates; keeping copies of photos and documents is always wise.

💡 Why It Matters

  • Improved battery visibility helps users extend device runtime.
  • Enhanced privacy controls give users more granular app management.
  • Faster search in Google Photos and custom route shortcuts in Maps streamline everyday tasks.
  • The October security patch addresses critical vulnerabilities, reinforcing device security across the ecosystem.

#android #android17 #mobileupdates #privacy #security

Source: Android Daily News: October 10, 2026 – Latest Updates and Releases - thetechpapa
